B4B Payments has evolved from prepaid cards to a broader financial operations platform for direct businesses and platform partners with more complex needs. Contact usWhy B4B Payments Company timeline 20 years of building financial infrastructure. 2006 - Founded Founded as Payment Card Solutions (PCS). One of the first companies in the UK to build prepaid expense solutions for businesses. 2008–2017 - Expanded Expanded into payroll disbursement, incentives, rewards, and corporate expense management. Built partnerships across travel, charity, education, and financial services. 2018 - Rebranded Rebranded as B4B Payments to reflect a broader vision beyond prepaid cards. 2020 - EMI licences in the UK and EU UK Electronic Money Institution licence (Ref: 930619) granted by the FCA, and EU EMI (Licence No: 76) granted by the Bank of Lithuania. 2020–2021 - Banking Circle and US Became part of the Banking Circle Group with full banking licence and leading payments infrastructure. Expanded into the US. 2023–2026+ - Platform evolution Evolving into a full-stack financial platform with accounts, payments, FX, cards, and spend management, powered by Banking Circle. Leadership The team behind B4B Payments. Tom Jennings Chief Executive Officer (Global) Over 20 years in the payments industry, including as Managing Director of one of the UK's largest EMIs and Head of Issuing at Banking Circle. Tom leads B4B Payments globally. Kieran Draper Chief Executive Officer (USA) Kieran leads B4B Payments' US operations from Boston. He brings senior leadership experience from Capgemini and Ernst and Young across financial services and technology transformation. Matt Hart Chief Technology Officer Matt has extensive experience building and delivering payment technology solutions at scale. He leads B4B Payments' technology platform, including card processing infrastructure. Luke McAlpine Chief Product Officer Luke leads product strategy and development at B4B Payments, bringing experience from Visa, Thought Machine, and HSBC. Ken O'Shaughnessy Chief Operating Officer Ken leads B4B Payments' operations, with extensive experience in card payments and prepaid solutions. Paul Newman Head of Finance Paul leads finance operations at B4B Payments, with previous experience across financial services.
